issue.title: Can't run GUI on Ubuntu 26.04 with wayland: `qt.qpa.plugin: Could not find the Qt platform plugin "wayland" in ""`
issue.body:
### Issues, reports or feature requests related to the GUI should be opened directly on the GUI repo

- [x] I still think this issue should be opened here

### Report

Trying to run bitcoin-qt after upgrading ubuntu 24.04 to 26.04 and I'm getting errors:

```
qt.qpa.plugin: Could not find the Qt platform plugin "wayland" in ""
```

`export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=wayland` gets me:

```
qt.qpa.plugin: Could not find the Qt platform plugin "wayland" in ""
This application failed to start because no Qt platform plugin could be initialized. Reinstalling the application may fix this problem.

Available platform plugins are: minimal, xcb.

[1]    250800 IOT instruction (core dumped)  DISPLAY=:1 ~/bitcoin/bitcoin-31.1/bin/bitcoin-qt
```

```
ldd ~/bitcoin/bitcoin-31.1/bin/bitcoin-qt
        linux-vdso.so.1 (0x00007ae8816e3000)
        libfontconfig.so.1 => /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libfontconfig.so.1 (0x00007ae881660000)
```
